1790258960962146491 [2024-05-14] @algekalipso 💜 19 [(SEED) type=semantic_search]
The following tweet contains very heavy spoilers for the Three-Body Problem series, so be warned. 

...

One of the key concepts in the series is the idea of the dark forest, where the solution to the Fermi paradox is that there is a huge amount of life, but for it to survive, it needs to be quiet, or be quiet and exterminate the civilizations it encounters. It does this because of another concept called chains of suspicion, compounded by the fact that there are technological explosions. So even relatively primitive civilizations become extremely dangerous rather quickly. Therefore, for raw evolutionary reasons, everybody needs to either hide or figure out how to be powerful enough to neutralize others. And it seems like the universe is actually the result of this defection on the commons, where all of the universe is in fact three-dimensional because flattening things is a way to neutralize them. And those who are powerful enough to do that oftentimes are also powerful enough to then figure out how to live in a lower dimension.

I think this has a non-trivial and rather funny application or correspondence to corporate dynamics, especially in light of something like the sociopaths, clueless, and losers model of @vgr  

The key insight here is that flattening of possibility space is itself a kind of ultimate weapon in forms of social organization. And in this case, clearly defining the roles and responsibilities of the clueless layer is in fact kind of this lower dimensional universe caused by the conquering behavior of sociopaths, all the while losers actually stay hidden and avoid the dark forest so as to not collapse their possibility space by quote-unquote organizational requirements.

This of course is not universal to organizations, but having worked at a place where I analyzed hundreds, even thousands of companies and the internal dynamics that make the employees happy or unhappy, productive or unproductive, I am led to believe that a very big percentage of the shape at the macroscopic level of organizations have something to do with dark forest dynamics. Many re-orgs are lower dimensional compactifications of possibility space, where those who initiate them adapt in advance to live and thrive in those lower dimensions. Like the corporate slave who has decided to live, breath, and eat corp-speak.

1946311621753680289 [2025-07-18] @Andercot 💜 271 🔁 23
Dark Forest theory is retarded because we've had halfway decent tech for maybe 100 years when it comes to seeing jack shit in space.

If we see them now it means they're everywhere, abundant, teeming, hanging out on the moon and Mars and watching us flail around and waiting for us to grow up.

It's like the North Sentinalese looking up at a B2 bomber and thinking it's for them, because the US is afraid of them, concerned about the competition.

Get real.

You're in a museum, a historical curiosity, a genetic experimental testing ground, some kind of remedial college for ape men too violent and small minded to get a proper hello. If they sent a missionary offering free energy and immortality the Earthers would bash his head in with a rock because it's a threat to capitalism or oil and gas or the pharmaceutical industry for the same reason North Sentinalese eat Christian missionaries - they're just not there yet. 

Hell, if Jesus was an alien sent to Earth to kick our asses all in the right direction by preaching love and forgiveness and to stop living in fear and what did we do? The dudes who lend money convinced the dudes who make people fight to the death as a spectacle sport nail him to a cross on a hill next to a couple thieves.

We're an embarrassment, we're the penal colony of interstellar space, the solar Australia, a reality TV show, the dunce corner for regressive souls. Extra terrestrial tourists going river rafting would look over to see ol inbred hybrid humans sitting on their porch, banging their cousins, playing the banjo, forehead like a brick, slack jawed, drooling, uncomprehending. The Angels went to Sodom and Gomorrah and all the humans wanted to do was rape them. We are the yokels in need of Deliverance.

You think space faring civilizations roll out the red carpet for planets where the reigning nuclear superpower puts child traffickers into witness protection programs, where teenagers fly FPV explosive drones into each other's dugouts to pad the bottom line of defense corps, where even Jesus' legacy of the Catholic church gets in on the child trafficking?

Absolutely fuck no.

Whatever's going on up there isn't coming down here to sort our shit out for the same reason you don't hand out AK47's to warring tribes whose rate limiter on genocide is how sharp they can keep their machetes. 

Nope. We are not alone but we're on our own when it comes to growing up. 

The forest is full of lights, and we are the dark.
